title.narrative: Africa Programme for Peace Development Engagement1.1 African Union Preventive Diplomacy & Mediation

description.narrative: The overall objective of the development cooperation between the parties is that: Denmark has contributed to the African Union’s ability to promote conflict prevention and democratic governance, which is drawn from Aspirations 3 and 4 of the Agenda 2063 strategy. The engagement will contribute to this objective through supporting the following two outcomes: • Outcome 1: More effective, coordinated and timely direct and structural prevention of conflicts and crises by the AU. Within this outcome area, the principal focus will be on strengthening the AU’s capacity for preventative diplomacy and mediation. Support will also be provided to the AU Liaison Offices (AULOs) given their important role in preventative diplomacy and implementation of PSC decisions, as well as the AU Border Programme (AUBP), which contributes to structural prevention. • Outcome 2: Electoral management improved and capacities for election observation and follow up strengthened. Within this outcome area, the principal focus will be on supporting the AU’s increasing role regarding long-term elections observation and support to Electoral Management Bodies (EMBs). Where elections in Africa have frequently been a source of conflict, there is a clear link between progress here and conflict prevention.
